follow-up time: From late second trimester to delivery
exposure: Gestational age at scan (24-28 weeks and beyond 36 weeks)
Cesarean scar thickness at 24-28 weeks gestation
Cesarean scar thickness beyond 36 weeks gestation
cohort: Pregnant women with a history of one previous cesarean section.
finding: Thicker cesarean scars measured by transvaginal sonography in the late second and third trimester were associated with a higher likelihood of successful vaginal birth.
mod_finding: Thicker cesarean scars were associated with a higher likelihood of successful vaginal birth.
